synth.direction: Conversational and plain, like a reporter walking someone through the record. Start on the first word with no lead-in and keep the connecting words moving. Carry each line's emphasis through stress on its one phrase, never through volume, and never add a triumphant note to a fix or a completed step. Take natural breaths at commas and sentence ends, and run 'flood remedy' straight into 'as currently under development' with no breath. Keep every hedge (may, could, interim, currently) audible inside its own phrase. Land the final phrase quiet, level and complete, with no rising tone at the end.
